digest.component_or_area: reconciler apply and child process runtime management
propositions: Write/apply and subprocess paths currently rebuild config or reuse broad parent environments, allowing unintended scope writes and credential leakage to sibling processes
Jira Cloud scope has implicit DIG fallbacks in four locations: write path, live access-check probe, runtime default, and create-time default

Child environment builder must enforce same-capability inheritance, owning adapter overlays, unrelated sibling secret removal, and preservation of native SDK variables without mutating global os.environ
All implicit DIG defaults must be eliminated so requests fail closed unless DIG is explicitly configured, with no provider mutation or DIG-targeted probes occurring for unconfigured scopes
Concurrent operations with different overlays must not mutate global environment or leak credentials across operations
